tone_inputs: Full locally collected title and prose for all 200 original sample IDs; code excluded.
tone_blinding: Individual M3 labels and VADER predictions were excluded from the annotation view. Aggregate M3 counts had been observed in the repository audit.
topic_blinding: Not blind: M4-provided names were visible during the prior audit. Names use all 15 terms and all 10 supplied example titles per topic.
tone_rule: Negative: expressed frustration, distress or personal struggle; positive: expressed optimism, praise, satisfaction or actual gratitude; neutral: factual technical requests/failures. Technical error vocabulary and conventional courtesy alone are neutral. In mixed cases sustained frustration outweighs a closing thanks.
limitations: Subjective AI interpretation; no guarantee of label correctness.
Not a replacement for the original plan requirement of two independent human raters.
No AI-authored label is copied into label_m2, label_m3 or agreed_tone.
Topic names are interpretive proposals; topic 2 remains mixed.
